subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add a compaction-specific staged Gateway/WebChat diagnostics contract, and which compaction facts are safe to expose to users or operators?
rationale: The missing behavior is real by source inspection, but the fix adds public event/API or CLI surface, diagnostics retention/redaction policy, and overlaps the plugin path for running-summary context engines.

options.title: Narrow Core Observability Contract
options.body: Extend existing session.operation or diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata while documenting running summaries as a context-engine plugin pattern.

options.title: Docs And Existing Notices Only
options.body: Keep current start/end indicators, notifyUser, compaction-notifier, and diagnostics.stability, then improve discoverability for existing knobs and plugin paths.

options.title: Dedicated Compaction Diagnostics API
options.body: Add a new compaction-specific endpoint or CLI with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow Core Observability Contract
recommendation.body: Extend existing session.operation or diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata while documenting running summaries as a context-engine plugin pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the WebChat compaction progress event path that would likely anchor a narrow core contract.
